The '''Wildmane Water Well''' is located just north of [[Thunder Bluff]].{{co|43|13|Mulgore}} It is the northernmost of the tauren people's sacred water wells. This well had been taken over by the [[Venture Company]] in order to control the water supply but were run off by the tauren
